accountProcessingSettingsScreen.enableAiProcessingDesc: Allow Yoocood to analyze and process messages from this account
accountProcessingSettingsScreen.aiActiveMessage: AI is actively analyzing messages based on your rules below
accountProcessingSettingsScreen.howAiProcessingBody: When enabled, Yoocood analyzes incoming messages to suggest topics, create reminders, detect events, and prioritize important emails based on your configured rules.

processingModeScreen.infoBody: Choose whether AI should process all incoming messages or only from specific sources you trust.
processingModeScreen.featureWhitelistedControl: More control over what AI sees
processingModeScreen.recommendationsBody: Start with 'Process Only Whitelisted' for better privacy control. You can always switch to 'Process All' later if needed.

whitelistScreen.howBody: Only messages from these email addresses or domains will be processed by AI. Add trusted senders to ensure important messages are always analyzed.
whitelistScreen.tipsBody:
• Use domains (@company.com) to allow all emails from that organization
• Add specific addresses (john@example.com) for individual contacts
• Whitelist overrides ignore list settings

ignoreListScreen.howBody: Messages from these sources will never be processed by AI, even if global processing is enabled or they match trigger rules.
ignoreListScreen.priorityBody: Ignore list takes priority over all other settings. Even if a sender is whitelisted, they won't be processed if they're on the ignore list.
ignoreListScreen.tipsBody:
• Block domains (@spam.com) to ignore all emails from that organization
• Add specific addresses for individual senders
• Use for newsletters, promotional emails, or automated messages

triggerRulesScreen.howBody: Define conditions for when AI should process messages. Rules are applied in addition to your whitelist and processing mode settings.
triggerRulesScreen.examplesBody:
• Subject contains 'urgent' or 'deadline'
• From equals 'boss@company.com'
• Subject starts with '[ACTION REQUIRED]'

timeRangeScreen.enableSubtitle: Limit AI processing to specific hours and days
timeRangeScreen.enableStatusMessage: AI will only process messages during selected hours and day
timeRangeScreen.whyBody: Limit AI processing to working hours to avoid notifications during off hours. Messages received outside the time range will be queued and processed during the next active period.

ruleSummaryScreen.statusFooter: AI processes emails only from selected sources between 9 AM - 6 PM on Weekdays (Mon-Fri)
ruleSummaryScreen.howRulesIntro: Your AI processing rules are applied in this priority order:

Hi Team,

I need your approval on the Q4 budget proposal by EOD Friday. The total amount is $45,000 for the marketing campaign.

Please review the attached document and let me know if you have any questions.

Key points:
- Digital advertising: $25,000
- Content creation: $15,000
- Analytics tools: $5,000

Looking forward to your response

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
Marketing Director
